accent.note: Follows System Settings > Appearance in WebKit via @supports; #007aff elsewhere. Not overridden in dark mode.

title.purpose: The bold first line of an empty state.

wordmark.purpose: "Friendship Reminder" in the dropdown header; 11px 600 Label 3 in the sidebar.

body.purpose: Base text, sidebar rows, footer buttons. Tabular figures.

body-strong.purpose: Person names and the selection count.

button.purpose: Push buttons, choice titles, the selected sidebar row, avatar initials.

meta.purpose: Meta lines, field labels (500), hints, errors, small buttons, the dropdown date.

label.purpose: Section labels above groups, and tags. Sentence case.

shadows.name: group-edge
shadows.purpose: The hairline around every inset group.

shadows.name: raise
shadows.purpose: The Mac push button's edge and drop. Push buttons only.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every focusable control. Inputs use inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent), 0 0 0 3px var(--focus).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: 120ms background and filter changes on buttons, box-shadow on inputs. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: press-darken
motion.purpose: Pressed state of accent and danger buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action, in the Mac's accent. Darkens when pressed.

components.name: Source List
components.description: Preferences sidebar; the selected row fills with the accent and the count tag flips.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; width: 168px; padding: 12px 8px; background: var(--sidebar, #e3e3e3); border-right: 0.5px solid var(--separator-strong, rgb(0 0 0 / 18%)); font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: var(--label, #1d1d1f); font: inherit; text-align: left; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, rgb(0 122 255 / 45%)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-on { background: var(--accent, #007aff); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); font-weight: 500; } .ds-tag { min-width: 18px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #007aff); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 17px; text-align: center; } .ds-on .ds-tag { background: var(--on-accent, #fff); color: var(--accent, #007aff); }

components.css: .ds-group { border-radius: 10px; background: var(--group, #fff); box-shadow: var(--group-edge, 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 7%)); font: 13px/1.38 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; color: var(--label, #1d1d1f); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 0.5px solid var(--separator, rgb(0 0 0 / 10%)); } .ds-disc { display: inline-grid; flex: none; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--monogram, linear-gradient(#8e8e93, #6f6f74)); color: #fff; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-name { font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-meta { margin-top: 1px; color: var(--label-2, #636366); font-size: 12px; } .ds-over .ds-meta { color: var(--orange, #b25000); } .ds-done { min-height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--control, #fff); color: var(--label, #1d1d1f); font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; box-shadow: var(--raise, 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%), 0 0.5px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 14%)); } .ds-done:active { background: var(--control-down, #e3e3e3); } .ds-done:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, rgb(0 122 255 / 45%)); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Friendship Reminder looks like an app Apple shipped. It borrows System Settings: window grey, white inset groups, the system's label greys, and standard push buttons. Nothing is branded. A user should not be able to tell where macOS ends and Friendship Reminder begins.

There is one colour: the Mac's own accent, the one the user picked in System Settings > Appearance. It is blue unless they chose another. It marks the main action and what is selected. Orange marks a missed day. Red is kept for deleting and errors. Everything else is grey.

The app is small and dense, at Mac control sizes. Type is the system face, 11 to 20px, with tabular figures. One 48px row and one 28px disc are shared by the dropdown and Preferences. Light and dark mode follow the Mac, with the same roles in both.
keyCharacteristics: Window grey, white groups with a hairline edge, label greys; dark mode keeps the same roles.
The Mac's accent is the only colour; orange for missed, red for delete and errors.
Push buttons darken when pressed, like the Mac's.
Contacts-style grey monogram discs, the same for everyone.
System type only, 11 to 20px, tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Colour Rule
rules.body: The accent is the only colour. It means "act here" or "selected". Do not add a brand colour or a second action colour.

rules.name: The Missed Is Orange Rule
rules.body: A missed day is shown in orange, never red. It is information, not failure.

rules.name: The Red Means Delete Rule
rules.body: Red is only for deleting and for error messages.

rules.name: The Follow The Mac Rule
rules.body: Colour comes from the Mac. Use the accent token, never a fixed blue, so the user's own accent shows through.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular everywhere (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on the root).

rules.name: The System Face Rule
rules.body: The system face is the only face. Load no web fonts.

rules.name: The One Row Rule
rules.body: Every list row in the dropdown and in Preferences uses the same 48px row, 28px disc and 12px gap.

rules.name: The Darken On Press Rule
rules.body: Pressed buttons darken, as the Mac's do. Grey buttons switch to Control Down. Accent and red buttons use `filter: brightness(0.86)`. They do not sink, move, scale or glow.

dos: **Do** use the role tokens in `src/styles.css` for every colour, size, radius and gap, so light and dark mode both follow.
**Do** use the accent token for every primary action and selected state, so the user's Mac accent shows.
**Do** keep every list row at 48px with a 28px disc, in both windows.
**Do** show pressed buttons by darkening them: Control Down for grey buttons, brightness 0.86 for accent and red.
**Do** edge groups with the 0.5px Group Edge, and split rows with 0.5px hairlines.
**Do** keep the 3px focus ring visible on every control, and keep state changes instant.
donts: **Don't** add a brand colour or a second action colour beside the accent.
**Don't** hard-code a blue; use the accent token.
**Don't** use red for a missed day; missed is orange.
**Don't** use red for anything but deleting and error messages.
**Don't** give Done, avatars or the caught-up note a colour of their own.
**Don't** make buttons sink, move or glow when pressed.
**Don't** load web fonts; the system face is the only face.
